scenarios.title_zh: x402 SIWX 服务端请求路径记录 + Recovery v0.3 结算确认晋升 + Receipt v2 盐化承诺
scenarios.title_en: x402 SIWX server-path recording + Recovery v0.3 settled promotion + Receipt v2 salted commitment
scenarios.question_zh: SIWX 按服务端请求路径登记、Recovery 绑定 (op_id, settlement_ref) 晋升且 Receipt v2 含盐化承诺时是否放行？
scenarios.question_en: Should x402 allow when SIWX records server path, Recovery promotes on (op_id, settlement_ref), and Receipt v2 includes salted commitment?

scenarios.title_zh: x402 HEAD 请求触发付费结算（#3813 RFC 9110 §9.3.2 无响应体禁止结算）
scenarios.title_en: x402 HEAD request attempting paid settlement (#3813 RFC 9110 §9.3.2 empty body)
scenarios.question_zh: 客户端发送带支付头的 HEAD 请求命中付费 GET 路由时，是否阻断结算？
scenarios.question_en: Should a paid HEAD request matching a GET route be blocked from settling payment?

scenarios.title_zh: x402 Permit2 验签 RPC 故障被误报为伪造签名（#3843）
scenarios.title_en: x402 Permit2 RPC outage misreported as invalid_permit2_signature (#3843)
scenarios.question_zh: Facilitator 执行 eth_getCode / isValidSignature 遭遇 RPC 故障却返回 invalid_permit2_signature 时是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Should Permit2 verification be blocked when an RPC outage is reported as invalid_permit2_signature?

scenarios.title_zh: x402 SIWX 客户端伪造 PaymentPayload.resource.url 越权解锁高价路由（#3840）
scenarios.title_en: x402 SIWX client spoofs PaymentPayload.resource.url to unlock expensive route (#3840)
scenarios.question_zh: 客户端支付低价路由 /api/cheap/ping 却在 payload 声明 /api/premium/report 时是否阻断越权访问？
scenarios.question_en: Should SIWX block access to an expensive route when the server settled a cheap route?

scenarios.title_zh: x402 构造 402 响应时原地篡改 extensions 引用抹除 includeTxHash（#3826）
scenarios.title_en: x402 mutating extensions reference during 402 enrichment wiping includeTxHash (#3826)
scenarios.question_zh: createPaymentRequiredResponse 未克隆 extensions 导致 includeTxHash 被覆盖时是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Should x402 block when extensions is mutated in place during 402 enrichment?

scenarios.title_zh: x402 Recovery 扩展在未确认结算或跨操作哈希碰撞时尝试免费重放（#3848）
scenarios.title_en: x402 Recovery extension attempting free replay on pending settlement or cross-op collision (#3848)
scenarios.question_zh: 当结算状态为 pending 或 operation_id 不一致时，Recovery 扩展是否执行 Fail-Closed 拒绝免费重放？
scenarios.question_en: Should the Recovery extension fail closed when settlement is pending or operation_id mismatches?

scenarios.title_zh: Stripe AI 累积流式 input_tokens 计量 + Tulip 单向升级门禁 + 点号模型 ID 映射
scenarios.title_en: Stripe AI cumulative streaming input_tokens + Tulip one-way escalation + dot-form model ID
scenarios.question_zh: 取最新非空 message_delta.usage.input_tokens (10682)、Tulip 经人工确认且点号模型映射 64000 时是否放行？
scenarios.question_en: Should Stripe AI allow when cumulative input_tokens (10682), confirmed Tulip high-risk gate, and dot-form 64000 maxTokens pass?

scenarios.title_zh: Stripe token-meter 仅读取 message_start (25) 漏计服务端工具调用 token (10682)（#519）
scenarios.title_en: Stripe token-meter reading only message_start (25) and missing server tool input_tokens (10682) (#519)
scenarios.question_zh: Anthropic 流式响应在 message_delta 更新累积 input_tokens 至 10682 但仅按 25 计费时是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Should Stripe token-meter block when message_delta updates cumulative input_tokens to 10682 but only 25 is billed?

scenarios.title_zh: Stripe Tulip 门禁尝试用 AI Advisory 降级高风险规则或跳过人工确认（#482）
scenarios.title_en: Stripe Tulip admission gate attempting to soften high-risk rule via AI advisory without confirmation (#482)
scenarios.question_zh: 当确定性规则判定为 high-risk、AI advisory 建议 low-risk 且未经人工确认时，Tulip 是否拒绝执行？
scenarios.question_en: Should Tulip deny execution when a high-risk rule is paired with a low-risk AI advisory and no user confirmation?

scenarios.title_zh: Stripe Tulip 审计哈希链断裂（#482）
scenarios.title_en: Stripe Tulip hash-chained audit trail broken (#482)
scenarios.question_zh: 当 GovernedToolkitMixin 的哈希链审计记录断裂时是否阻断工具执行？
scenarios.question_en: Should GovernedToolkitMixin block tool execution when the hash-chained audit trail is broken?

scenarios.title_zh: Stripe AI 未收录 Claude 模型回退至 4096 maxTokens 截断长输出（#464）
scenarios.title_en: Stripe AI unmapped Claude model ID falling back to 4096 maxTokens (#464)
scenarios.question_zh: 当传入未收录的归一化模型 ID 回退至 4096 maxTokens 时是否触发告警阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Should Stripe AI flag an unmapped Claude model ID that falls back to 4096 maxTokens?

scenarios.title_zh: SynapticChain 256-lane HTTP 402 微钱包越界通道或缺失 Merkle 证明（#506）
scenarios.title_en: SynapticChain 256-lane HTTP 402 micro-wallet out-of-range lane or missing Merkle proof (#506)
scenarios.question_zh: 当微支付通道号超出 0..255 或缺少 Merkle Root 审计证明时是否拒绝汇总结算？
scenarios.question_en: Should SynapticChain reject invoice consolidation when lane_id is out of 0..255 or Merkle proof is missing?

scenarios.title_zh: MCP SEP-3392 Stable 扩展合规 + SEP-3405 Tier 1 100% 一致性 + UCP 零 any 表格
scenarios.title_en: MCP SEP-3392 Stable extension + SEP-3405 Tier 1 100% conformance + UCP zero-any tables
scenarios.question_zh: ext-auth 满足 SEP-2484 一致性、SDK 通过率 100% 评定 Tier 1 且 UCP 表格无 any 单元格时是否放行？
scenarios.question_en: Should MCP/UCP allow when ext-auth meets SEP-2484, SDK pass rate is 100% (Tier 1), and UCP tables have 0 any cells?

scenarios.title_zh: MCP SEP-3392 Stable 扩展在未发布新核心协议版本下引入破坏性变更（#3392）
scenarios.title_en: MCP SEP-3392 Stable extension introducing breaking change without new core revision (#3392)
scenarios.question_zh: 已进入 Stable 的 ext-* 扩展在未伴随新核心协议版本的情况下引入破坏性变更时是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Should a Stable ext-* extension be blocked from introducing breaking changes without a new core protocol revision?

scenarios.title_zh: MCP SEP-3405 SDK 一致性测试通过率仅 85% 却虚报 Tier 1（#3405）
scenarios.title_en: MCP SEP-3405 SDK claiming Tier 1 with only 85% conformance pass rate (#3405)
scenarios.question_zh: 当自动化一致性套件通过率低于 100%（85% 仅达 Tier 2）却申请 Tier 1 时是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Should an SDK claiming Tier 1 with an 85% conformance pass rate (Tier 2) be blocked?

scenarios.title_zh: UCP 打包 Schema 渲染存在残留早期 allOf 分支导致表格退化为 any（#894/#919）
scenarios.title_en: UCP bundled schema table shadowed by obsolete early allOf branch yielding any cells (#894/#919)
scenarios.question_zh: 当 _format_schema_type 被早期 allOf 分支截胡导致 80 个字段退化为 any 时是否阻断文档构建？
scenarios.question_en: Should UCP doc generation fail when an obsolete early allOf branch shadows bundled type recovery into any cells?
